proved: Messaging receipts are immutable and their replay consumption is recorded separately in an append-only table.
The restricted role has no direct DML on messaging approvals, receipts, invitations, messages, or receipt consumptions.
An invitation needs two distinct current trusted approvals, a current receipt, exact workspace authority, and an active invited member.
A contractor channel message needs a current invitation, its consumed dual approvals, and a fresh receipt bound to its exact message ID.
The disposable PostgreSQL suite denied direct receipt-table writes, rejected invitation replay, and proved one exact invitation and message flow.
notProved: A production messaging provider, route, UI, or browser accessibility evidence.
The identity/session-role mapping that distinguishes contractors from every other non-admin membership at the database boundary.
Production deployment, measured production revocation, independent human review, or release authority.
